Nina V.: FYI we have an incoming customer security call with VegaHealth. They want: RBAC change history for specific users, KMS usage logs for a 7-day window, and confirmation of vuln triage cadence. Can we prepare quick answers?
Omar T.: For user-level RBAC history, we can export audit traces and role_binding deltas. Note: privacy policy requires obfuscation of personal emails unless customer provides signed request.
Ben C.: KMS logs: provide ops with key_id, op, request_id, ts. We can supply HSM attestation statement from cloud provider if needed.
sec-automation-bot: Tip: `evidence export --tenant veg ahealth --window 7d --kind kms,r bac --sign`
Nina V.: The customer also asked about time-to-restore SLA after suspected key exposure. What's our incident playbook?
Omar T.: We rotate affected keys, revoke derived credentials, and provide a cross-service timeline. RTO varies by key usage surface; typical containment within 1-3 hours for high-impact keys.
Ben C.: For vuln triage cadence: weekly triage meetings, follow-up SLAs for fix PRs set by severity (P0 24h, P1 7d). Provide an exported triage log and ticket refs.
Contracts: If VegaHealth wants contractual SLAs on retention or HSM certs, escalate to contracts for amendment.
Nina V.: Action items: Omar export RBAC traces for requested users, Ben export KMS 7d logs and attestations, I will draft the call script and include PR triage summary.
Omar T.: RBAC traces by EOD.
Ben C.: KMS logs + attestation stub by tomorrow.
sec-automation-bot: Reminder to tag artifacts with `vega-evidence` and store in /run/evidence/vegahealth/
Nina V.: thanks, will follow up after call.
